scenario: Submit an ID-only change request while preserving State Service as the sole business-write and authorization boundary.

output.semantics: M4 always returns a machine-readable refusal and never applies or activates a plan version.

dependent_tool_system.authority: Program State Service alone validates and decides the request.

failure_handling.missing_or_invalid_decision: Return the State Service refusal unchanged.
failure_handling.unexpected_success: Stop and report a write-boundary violation.
